historical_references.reference: Sarojini Chatterjee, a prominent Indian freedom fighter and writer, was born on 3 September 1888 in the village of Kishoreganj in the Bengal Presidency of British India. She was one of the earliest women to join the Indian National Congress and was active in the Indian independence movement from her youth.

Sarojini Naidu, also known as the 'Nightingale of India', was a renowned Indian poet, author, and a Freedom Fighter. She was born on 13 February 1879 in Hyderabad, India, in a wealthy aristocratic family. She became the first Indian woman to be elected as the President of the Indian National Congress in 1925.
